note: Chat-HITL PROGRAM ACCEPTANCE manifest (cinatra#2573, epic #2564 S7). One row per LITERAL acceptance criterion in #2573's issue body — 16, verbatim and in order; the gate pins them against its own CANONICAL_CRITERIA so a row can never drift from the issue's wording. `disposition` is the row's honest state: MAPPED (already fully proven by a landed slice's own test — S7 never re-authors what a sibling owns), BUILT (S7's own artifact, because the criterion had no owner), MISSING (not proven; `gap` says why, in a sentence, and `partial` marks a criterion whose clauses are only partly met). Hand-authored against the issue text — there is no regeneration mode and there must not be one, because the rows are claims a human makes, not facts a scanner discovers. Every {file, testName} pair is re-verified against the real tree on every run of the gate.

rows.criterion: Chat-dispatch → typed chip-row hold → confirm → artifact → review card renders island + capture pair → focused-composer comment → `changes_requested` → repair successor in the same chat → verification chip → approve → effects release.
rows.gap: Every LINK of the chain is proven, and the chain as ONE production-equivalent Playwright journey is not. The links: the hold parks and releases (recommendation-hold.integration), the review card renders the island + the pinned capture pair on all three first-party hosts (review-gate-card), changes_requested closes the base gate and pins a repair successor and approve releases the held effect (lifecycle-repair.integration), the successor mints the verification record (lifecycle-verification.integration). What is NOT proven is the WHOLE walk on one live chat thread, and one step of it is not merely unproven but UNIMPLEMENTED: the 'focused-composer comment'. agentic-run-panel.tsx still publishes a NULL composer descriptor for a marked review gate (the cinatra#1796 single-resume guard) and its own comment records that binding the composer to a FOCUSED card 'is a separate, deliberate step (#2566's composer-focus deliverable)' — that step never landed. The comment IS reachable in chat, from the card's own decision bar; the composer-bound form of it is not. Defect D-2 in the S7 report.

rows.criterion: Late stream subscription + reload re-render (decided gate shows resolved state); multiple concurrent gates require explicit composer focus.
rows.gap: The first clause is fully proven; the second is UNIMPLEMENTED. Late subscription and reload re-render are covered: the run stream answers a late joiner with the CURRENT hold as its first frame and reconstructs it on a Last-Event-ID reconnect, and the card re-resolves the authoritative state on mount/focus so a decided gate settles to the server's answer rather than a stale snapshot. The second clause — 'multiple concurrent gates require explicit composer focus' — has no implementation to test: agentic-run-panel.tsx publishes a NULL composer descriptor for every marked review gate, so no gate is ever composer-bound, focused or otherwise. S2 (#2566) named 'composer focus' as its own deliverable and deferred it in a source comment; it never landed. Defect D-2 in the S7 report.

Proven directly: CARD REFETCH and the island paint (review-island-serving refuses a swept or expired cwu_ row, a dead parent sign-in, a revoked site, a rotated credential generation and a lost membership), CAPTURE GET (capture-capability-serving refuses a gone cwu_ row, a moved binding and a reader who lost run access between mint and fetch) and DECISION (the decide route re-runs run READ for the same actor before the decision op and answers a denial byte-identically to a forged ref). rows.criterion: `/embed/assistant` renders captures with NO island and refuses a nested island by ancestry.
rows.gap: The criterion's FIRST clause is SUPERSEDED by a later sub-issue of this same epic and can no longer be proven, because the product deliberately does the opposite. S8e (cinatra#2674, merged as d7ff228f8) gave the island a second reader path — a short-lived, ref-bound ISLAND CREDENTIAL derived from the widget principal — precisely so the island DOES paint inside /embed/assistant on a genuinely cross-site deployment, where a SameSite-bound cookie is never sent into the frame. The epic's 2026-08-11 correction is the reason: the widget is a full-parity surface and a reduced capture-only tier was the removed premise. The landed behaviour is photographed in evidence/2577-parity (V2r-widget-review-card-island-painting.png). The SECOND clause is live and IS proven: the island's frame-ancestors wall admits 'self' plus the ONE server-resolved registered origin, an unregistered ancestor gets the first-party wall, no wildcard is ever emitted, and an attacker-supplied origin in the query is not a policy input. Recorded as MISSING rather than rewritten: changing an acceptance criterion to match what shipped is the coordinator's ruling to make, not this lane's.

rows.criterion: EXACTLY ONE card implementation per interaction across /chat, embed/widget, run card, and the review gate region — the parallel renderers (redirect card, panel chip-row mount, review-page direct composition) are gone (grep-gated).
rows.gap: The gate is BUILT and the three named parallel renderers are checked, but the criterion is not met: a FOURTH renderer of the recommendation interaction survives on the run-detail surface. packages/agents/src/instance-screens.tsx does its own recommendation-park read, its own candidate prefetch, and mounts <RunRecommendationChipRow holdRef={…}> directly — bypassing RecommendationHoldCard, the LifecycleCardSurfaceProvider host declaration and the card's authoritative-refetch contract. S4 (#2568) recorded it as 'deliberately unchanged by this branch'. It is not cosmetic: AgenticRunPanel (which mounts the card correctly under host="run_card") renders only for run.status !== 'pending_input', and a HELD run IS pending_input — so on the run-detail page the HELD state is drawn ONLY by the parallel path. It is allowlisted BY NAME in the gate with this justification so the gate reports the truth; deleting that allowlist entry is the fix. Defect D-1 in the S7 report. The redirect card and the review-page direct decision composition ARE gone and stay gone.

rows.criterion: Conformance vs the S0 spec matrix (per surface, per card, per state) on a production-equivalent build with recorded screenshots.
rows.gap: The STRUCTURAL conformance is proven bidirectionally against the pinned S0 spec commit (design@6c20871b4108176c1d0193f19ecd2947f6c6355f specs/app-lifecycle-cards.html): every spec anchor is rendered, and every anchor the route renders is in the spec's closed set. The RECORDED-SCREENSHOT half is PARTIAL. This lane built a production build on host2 (`pnpm build` + `next start`, not `next dev`) at branch head b63d64ad4 and captured three real cells against rows the shipped stores wrote — the review card PENDING on the page gate region (review-gate-card + review-decision-bar + review-target-island anchors, data-lifecycle-card-state="pending", the island iframe with its sandbox tokens and a server-minted ref, zero page errors), the island itself rendering the BUILD-MAP renderer class server-side, and the island's ONE empty document for a ref that does not decode. Three further cells were attempted and are recorded as NOT delivered with the reason each failed (evidence/2573-s7-conformance/README.md): the card's SETTLED state is unreachable by direct URL because the route answers a resolved gate with its own blocked panel before the card mounts; the verification advisory view did not resolve its record for this reader; and the run_card host never mounted because AgenticRunPanel renders only for a non-pending_input run. The chat and widget hosts, and the full 4 cards x 4 surfaces x 6 states cross-product, are NOT captured — reaching them needs an LLM-backed dispatch and the widget's hosted sign-in, which is a proof round of its own (the shape S8d/#2577 ran).
